title: Association Bias
coreMove: Detect when the association bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Association Bias as a specific decision error around association bias, messenger, gas leak. Traceable support includes s Almanack , expanded third edition (Virginia Beach: The Donning Company Publishers, 2006), 472..
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Association Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the association bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
